title: Malaysia Palm Oil EUDR Readiness
thesis: A fictional Malaysian palm oil group sources fresh fruit bunches from Sabah, Sarawak and Peninsular Malaysia. Snowflake turns its mill-intake records into plot traceability and flag-precision KPIs, 7-day canopy-loss risk scores, geolocation mismatch anomalies and grounded AI answers, all from curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: 40 supply bases: 8 mill-hub cities, from Sandakan and Tawau in Sabah to Sibu and Miri in Sarawak and Kuantan and Teluk Intan in the Peninsula, crossed with 5 supplier types.
Each KPI is a ratio of explicit numerator and denominator columns in a curated dynamic table, so any card can be traced to supply-base-day rows.
The risk-signal chart separates signals that end in confirmed canopy-loss cases from signals that mostly raise false-positive flags.
show: Daily FFB deliveries and screening flags
tabs.call_out: One governed set of traceability KPIs for every mill hub

transition.line: Where should the field verification team go this week?

talking_points: A Snowflake ML classifier gives each supply base a probability of a confirmed canopy-loss case within 7 days.
Precision and recall come from an out-of-time holdout of the latest labelled days and are shown next to the base rate.
Anomaly detection picks out geolocation mismatch outliers per supply base; the forecast projects group-wide FFB deliveries for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Triage scores with honest, published holdout metrics

transition.line: Is plot geolocation keeping pace with intake?

talking_points: Supplier declaration rate, plot geolocation coverage and the backlog of geolocation checks.
The scatter sets each supply base's declaration rate against its confirmed canopy-loss cases.
tabs.call_out: Close plot geolocation gaps before an EU buyer asks

transition.line: What happens when a truck arrives from an unmapped plot?

talking_points: Mill weighbridge FFB delivery events land in RAW.LIVE_DELIVERIES: simulated in Snowflake, or uploaded to S3 and loaded by Snowpipe in the AWS build.
FLAG events (no matching geolocated plot) are logged by the alert, which emails the traceability team.
tabs.call_out: Weighbridge to alert email on one platform

transition.line: Now ask the data in plain language.

talking_points: The Cortex Agent answers with SQL over the semantic view and cites the synthetic traceability SOPs by ID.
The action memo uses only KPI, supply base, risk-signal and risk rows; screening results are demo signals, not compliance verdicts.
show: Agent answer with SQL and SOP citations

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Both builds share one core: seeded data, dynamic tables, Snowflake ML, Cortex Search, semantic view, agent, alert and task graph.
The AWS build adds S3 uploads with Snowpipe, a Bedrock memo and a QuickSight dashboard with an Amazon Q topic.
